_meta.description: Seed framework and control lists for Firewall Audit Analyzer. Loaded into `frameworks` and `framework_controls` tables. Importer must be idempotent (upsert by frameworks.code and framework_controls(framework_id, control_code)).

coverage_legend.automated: Control can be fully assessed from config via mapped CIS rules.
coverage_legend.partial: Some aspects of the control are covered by CIS rules; the rest require judgment/manual verification.
coverage_legend.manual: Governance/process controls (policies, training, reviews) - cannot be derived from config; auditor fills manually.
coverage_legend.not_covered: Outside the scope of firewall config audit (e.g. physical security/HR) - displayed transparently, excluded from scoring.

_meta.IMPORTANT_NOTE_FOR_AI: Control codes (e.g. 'PR.AA-01', 'A.8.20', 'Req 1.2.1', 'AC-domain') are working representations based on public understanding of each framework. Before using for official audit/certification, verify control codes & titles against the latest official framework documents (especially Cyber Trust Mark CSA & PCI DSS v4.0.1). coverage_type is intentionally marked conservative (partial/manual) when in doubt.

frameworks.name: CIS FortiGate Benchmark
frameworks.description: Technical source of truth. Granular rules based on FortiOS configuration. Other frameworks map to these rules.

frameworks.name: Cyber Trust Mark (CSA Singapore)
frameworks.description: CSA Singapore certification mark based on cyber readiness domains (risk-based). Firewall focus: secure configuration, access control, logging, network security, patching. Many domains are governance-related (manual).

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Admin account management, least privilege, MFA, trusted hosts, timeouts.
controls.guidance: External MFA & AAA are not always visible in static config; verify manually if necessary.

controls.title: Secure/Hardened Configuration
controls.description: Baseline hardening: strong encryption, TLS, admin ports, USB auto-install, banners.

controls.title: Network Security
controls.description: Segmentation, policies without ANY, blocking malicious IPs (ISDB), WAN management access.

controls.title: Security Profiles / Threat Protection
controls.description: IPS, AV, Web/DNS/App controls applied to policies.

controls.title: Logging & Monitoring
controls.description: Event logging, centralized logging, log transit encryption.

controls.title: Secure Remote Access (VPN)
controls.description: SSL VPN with trusted certificates & strong TLS.

controls.title: Update & Patch Management
controls.description: Latest firmware, auto-update signatures, virtual patching.

controls.title: Governance & Risk Management
controls.description: Security policies, risk management, asset ownership.
controls.guidance: Requires policy documents & process evidence - auditor must fill manually.

controls.title: Security Awareness & Training
controls.guidance: Outside the scope of firewall configuration audits.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.guidance: Logging supports IR, but IR procedures are assessed manually.

controls.title: Data Backup
controls.guidance: Firewall config backups should be verified manually (not always present in config).

frameworks.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
frameworks.description: Outcome-based framework with 6 functions: Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover. Firewalls primarily address Protect & Detect.

controls.title: Policy for managing cybersecurity risk is established
Inventories of hardware are maintained
controls.description: Config hostnames/assets aid inventory; full inventory process is manual.

controls.title: Identities and credentials are managed
controls.description: Admin accounts, password policies, default admins.

controls.title: Access permissions incorporate least privilege & separation of duties
Networks & environments protected from unauthorized access
controls.description: Segmentation, policies, blocking malicious IPs, WAN management.

controls.title: Incident response process is executed
controls.guidance: IR procedures - manual verification (supported by logging).

frameworks.name: NIST SP 800-41 Rev.1 — Guidelines on Firewalls and Firewall Policy
frameworks.description: Specific guidelines for firewalls & firewall policies. Highly relevant to Section 1 & 3 (policies/objects) and logging.

controls.title: Ruleset enforces least privilege (deny by default, no ANY)
controls.description: Policies do not use ANY service; deny malicious traffic.

controls.title: Firewall logging is enabled and retained
Firewall management is secured
controls.description: Encrypted mgmt, trusted hosts, no WAN mgmt, admin ports.

controls.title: Firewall firmware kept up to date
Ruleset reviewed regularly
controls.guidance: Periodic rule reviews (hit counts) - manual/runtime verification.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Annex A Controls)
frameworks.description: ISMS standard. Annex A controls relevant to firewalls under themes: Access Control, Network Security, Logging, Cryptography, Configuration.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Policies & enforcement of admin access controls.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.description: Admin profile least privilege, trusted hosts.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Password policies, lockouts, encrypted channels, VPN authentication.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Network monitoring, SNMP traps, IPS/DNS logging.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.description: Segmentation, policies, blocking malicious traffic, WAN management.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Strong crypto, TLS, log transit encryption, VPN TLS.

frameworks.name: PCI DSS v4.0.1 (Network Security Requirements)
frameworks.description: Card data security standard. Requirement 1 (network security controls) & parts of Req 2/8/10 are relevant to firewalls.

controls.title: NSC ruleset restricts traffic to only necessary (deny by default)
controls.description: Policies without ANY, deny default/malicious traffic.

controls.title: Only necessary services/ports/protocols allowed
controls.description: Specific services, app controls for non-default ports.

controls.title: Inbound traffic to CDE restricted
controls.description: WAN mgmt disabled, inbound traffic restricted.

controls.title: Insecure services/protocols disabled or justified
controls.description: HTTP/Telnet off, SNMPv3 only, static TLS keys off.

controls.title: Wireless/vendor defaults changed
controls.description: Default admins removed, default ports changed.

controls.title: Audit logs enabled for all system components
Audit logs promptly backed up to central server
